lines.vo: You'll probably enjoy your workout more than you think you will.
That's not you being lazy. That's forecasting myopia.
When you picture a workout, your brain zooms in on the hardest part, the slow first few minutes.
In a set of studies, people predicted they'd enjoy exercise less than they actually did.
The fun middle part of the workout just didn't show up in their prediction.
When people pictured the whole thing, warm up to cool down, they felt more positive and planned to go more.
So Dre plans his whole session in his Fit and Strong Tracker, not just the hard start.
